title: AuditActor
description: Normalized reference to the actor who caused the event.

x-enumDescriptions: A human user authenticated via SSO or local account.
A machine identity using an org-scoped API key.
A site connector/agent operating on behalf of the org.

id.description: Actor ID. For `user` this is userId (UUID); for `api_key` this is apiKeyId (UUID); for `connector` this is connectorId (UUID). May be omitted for `system`.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the actor (e.g., full name or key name).

email.description: User email when actor is a human user.
